identity.primaryNarrative: Pat Probe is a data engineer at Probe Corp who builds warehouse pipelines and streaming ingestion.

strengths.name: Performance marketing
strengths.evidence: Built and ran paid acquisition (Google, Meta, programmatic) at $5M+ annual spend with CAC payback under 12 months.

strengths.name: Brand & content
strengths.evidence: Owned editorial calendar and brand voice across web, social, and email; led two refreshes from positioning to launch.

strengths.name: Analytics & experimentation
strengths.evidence: Built marketing analytics stack (GA4 + warehouse) and ran a continuous experimentation program with weekly tests.

strengths.name: Channel management
strengths.evidence: Managed an in-house + agency channel team of 6, coordinating launches across paid, organic, lifecycle, and partnerships.
